provenance: Host-local qwen settings shape, measured 2026-08-25 on spark (~/.qwen/settings.json): model.name + model.baseUrl, an env section referencing the API-key variable by name, and security.auth.selectedType. Per h17 the values are placeholders: the capability surface reports names and paths, never values — the tests assert the baseUrl value and the env value never appear in a section's output.
